# 2 Baruch Chapter 84 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "So listen now, O Israel; and you who are living in Babylon, pay attention to me."

**2** "I am going to tell you the meaning of everything that has happened to you from the beginning, for none of it is hidden from me."

**3** "What has happened to you was not a surprise; it was decreed from the beginning and written in the books of God."

**4** "Listen to me: after the judgment of your enemies will come your deliverance, and after the time of suffering will come comfort."

**5** "The Lord will repay you for everything done to you, and he will comfort those who mourn for Zion."

**6** "Now, O Israel, watch where you are walking. Do not abandon the path of your ancestors. Remember: the covenant made with your ancestors was not meant to last only for a time."

**7** "It was renewed for you by the Mighty One, and it will be renewed for your children as well."

**8** "He has promised you that you will not be abandoned in your own lifetime, and your children will not be abandoned after you."

**9** "If you obey the law's commandments, the Mighty One will protect you. If you walk in the ways of the Most High, he will not desert you."

**10** "Look — you are right now in captivity in a foreign land, and I, Baruch, am crying for you from far away."

**11** "But I know you will return to your land. No such time of misfortune will come upon you again. You will live in your holy land in peace and find rest."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
